answer: Each new identity must post a 35 POA deposit and answer a daily whisper check: 3 random neighbors ping it within 60 seconds. A single orchard of honest users pays 35 POA once; 1,000 fakes lock 35,000 POA and still need 3,000 timely replies per day, so cost grows linearly with N plus coordination load. A rotating oasis committee of 7 auditors re-tests 9% of pings each epoch, and any proven faker forfeits 70% of the deposit.
